author: Stahly
description:
I've tested the new Velvet Light Blenders from Kimera. There is no other paint like this on the market right now: white acrylic inks for highlighting and brightening up colours, but with a coloured twist. Can they really help you paint better highlights and push contrasts, or are they just an unnecessary gimmick? I'll explore all their uses in this video.

The post Unlike any other paint I tested so far: Kimera Velvet Light Blender inks appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Unlike any other paint I tested so far: Kimera Velvet Light Blender inks
